results.title: Christmas Party Games Printable Bundle, 14 Games, Bingo and Charades, Gift Tags and Place Cards, A4 and US Letter PDF
results.description:
Host a beautifully coordinated Christmas gathering with The Merry Gathering: 14 printable party games, matching gift tags and place cards in lavish burgundy, emerald and gold tones.

WHAT IS INCLUDED
34 unique designed pages supplied in two non-editable PDFs: A4 and US Letter. Both PDFs contain the same collection in different paper sizes.

14 GAMES
Christmas Trivia, Festive Word Scramble, Winter Word Search, Christmas A-Z, This or That, Most Likely To, Finish the Festive Phrase, Category Countdown, Would You Rather, Find a Festive Friend, Party Predictions, Holiday Memory, Christmas Bingo and Christmas Charades.

ALSO INCLUDED
8 different bingo boards for up to 8 guests or teams; 32 charades cards; bingo calling slips; 8 gift tags; 4 folded place cards; welcome sign; score sheet; host instructions and answer keys.

HOW TO USE
Download the ZIP file and unzip it. Choose A4 or US Letter and print single-sided at Actual Size / 100%. Use ordinary paper for games and printer-compatible cardstock for cut-apart cards. Cut and fold on the marked guides. English language; suggested ages 10+, with adult help for younger guests.

PLEASE NOTE
This is an instant digital download. No physical item, props, paper, pens or prizes are included. Gold-coloured details are standard printed colour, not metallic foil. PDFs are not editable. Personal use for your own celebrations only. Do not resell or redistribute the digital files. Decorative artwork created with AI assistance and assembled into the printable collection.

results.title: Christmas Party Games Printable Bundle, 12 Holiday Games for Family and Office, Bingo, Trivia
results.description:
12 printable Christmas party games in one download: bingo with 30 unique cards, trivia, charades, gift exchange games and more. Print at home tonight and play at your family Christmas, office holiday party, classroom or friends' night.

45 pages in every file. US Letter and A4, in full color and in an ink-saver version. Instant download, no app, no account.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✔ No peeking. Answer keys for trivia, emoji pictionary, word scramble and word search sit together at the back, for the host only.
✔ Safe for the office. Every question and card is clean and work-friendly, and the Left Right game has a family story and an office story.
✔ Original content. All questions, cards and stories are written for this bundle. No song lyrics, no movie characters.
✔ A winner at the end. A score sheet for all 12 games and 6 cut-out winner awards.
